title: access.resolved body
description: A person's decision on an access request or a change review, from the gateway to the team services.

decision_id.description: Made fresh for each decision the person submits, and kept when the gateway retries it. A decision corrected after a refusal gets a new one, so it is no duplicate of the refused one (registry idempotency).

choice.description: One of the choices the review offered: an access choice, or for a change review keep_current, use_change or stop_request. withdrawn_by_message is the gateway's, not a choice offered: the person wrote in the request's thread while a change review was open, so the gateway closed the card before passing the message on (README, "Change reviews"). The other fields belong to access reviews only.

keep.description: The review card's "Keep for later tasks" box; absent follows the choice.

hand_on.description: Whether the team lead may hand the access on to its workers' tasks without asking (its own requests only); absent means yes.
